import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageOps
from scipy import ndimage
im=Image.open('/app/radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.asarray(im).astype(float)
# local background: median blur large
bg=ndimage.median_filter(a,size=61)
diff=bg-a  # positive where darker than surroundings
# smooth
d=ndimage.gaussian_filter(diff,5)
# normalize
d=(d-np.percentile(d,2))/(np.percentile(d,98)-np.percentile(d,2))
np.save('/tmp/diff.npy',d)
out=(np.clip(d,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(out).save('/tmp/dog.png')
# overlay hot spots
hot=(d>0.6)
lbl,n=ndimage.label(hot)
sizes=ndimage.sum(hot,lbl,range(1,n+1))
import numpy as np
idx=np.argsort(sizes)[::-1][:30]
cents=ndimage.center_of_mass(hot,lbl,[i+1 for i in idx])
for s,c in zip(sizes[idx],cents):
    print(int(s), int(c[1]), int(c[0]))
